study.question: Under the single-pass frozen protocol, can separate normalized-content and count-scaled-content summary tokens reduce the observed click/auxiliary tradeoff relative to equal-capacity duplicate or early-fused summaries?
study.hypothesis: The same shared summary scale is an optimization bottleneck: normalized summaries favor auxiliary tasks while exposure-count scaling favors click under this recipe. Providing both views in distinct independently projected banks may let task prediction retain complementary scales. This adds no sample information: the parent already exposes log counts and all views are deterministic functions of the same authorized content. Proposed mechanism is a representation/conditioning bias, not evidence that learned activation intensity is necessary.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary v4 section4.3 lines271-277 already motivates unnormalized activation intensity. This proposal uses the inherited normalized per-field sigmoid retrieval, deterministic visible-count scaling and paired post-pooling tokens, rather than DIN event-level scalar local activation. Neither intensity preservation nor original novelty is claimed.

Pinned benchmark forward113-159 pools events then uses field/task tokens and heterogeneous interaction blocks. We inherit only the broad stacked pattern from the local ancestor and use paired summary-scale banks, shared small attention blocks and direct summary/static skips. Original paper text is unavailable through the authorized reader; no equivalence or priority claim.

Pinned benchmark forward112-158 uses global/group tokenizers after target pooling, reversible token mixing and mean readout. Proposed banks organize two scales of the same five inherited summaries; there is no reversible transport, global/chunk tokenizer or mean-token readout. Original full paper is unavailable; novelty remains unverified.

Only author README is available; it warns its behavior data has category/brand/type but no item IDs. Current histories are previous ad exposures under the frozen adapter. No original DMR mechanism or numerical result is imported.

study.proposed_difference: Replace the single five-token history-summary bank with two independently projected five-token banks. Candidate feeds (u,n*u/2); equal-capacity replacements feed (u,u), (n*u/2,n*u/2), or (f,f) with f=(u+n*u/2)/2. All arms retain pre-existing explicit group log counts and absence gates in both banks and the direct readout. n is exposure count, not individual feedback count. Task tokens and towers can combine either bank; a positive result cannot on its own locate the benefit in token interaction versus the raw summary skip.
predictions: Primary selection stays full-population validation click AUC; baseline-din remains incumbent at 0.6555440824200336 until a measured candidate exceeds it. All four AUC/logloss, auxiliary mean, parameter counts and measured cost must be reported even when primary fails.

Predeclared practical joint-benefit target: split improves click AUC by at least 0.002 over normalized_pair, stays within 0.001 click AUC of scaled_pair, and stays within 0.003 auxiliary mean AUC of normalized_pair while exceeding scaled_pair auxiliary mean by at least 0.003. These are screening margins, not significance thresholds.

Separate-bank evidence additionally requires split to exceed fused_pair in at least one task objective without violating the above click/auxiliary guardrails. A tie gives no separate-token mechanism support.

Evaluate paired differences within the existing bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64 histories, with sample/positive/negative counts. Prior normalized versus scaled differences are largest within short nonempty click histories; this is a preregistered follow-up prompted by exploratory historical slices. No empty-history direct-content benefit is expected; trained global parameters can still change its predictions.
falsifiers: If normalized_pair or scaled_pair matches/dominates split, the complementary-scale representation claim lacks support even if split beats a historical parent.
If fused_pair matches/dominates split, separate addressability is unsupported; report it as null or negative for the tested organization.
Click improvement coupled to auxiliary deterioration comparable to scaled_pair fails the predicted tradeoff relief. Auxiliary improvement alone cannot select a new incumbent.

NaNs, invalid masks, dependence on invisible padded item values, missing outputs or excessive runtime are implementation failures, not mechanism refutations. Retain receipts/costs and distinguish these from valid predictive failures.
A single successful seed is provisional; changed-seed reversal weakens the finding. No result establishes learned-gate intensity or temporal ordering mechanisms.
alternative_explanations: Observed historical scale differences could reflect count/prevalence or optimizer conditioning, not useful target-dependent intensity; mass_sum and count_scaled differ in click AUC by only 0.0000177175.
Extra projections, larger tower inputs and five additional tokens may explain gains over single-bank ancestors; new duplicate replacements match these additions exactly.
Normalized/scaled signals are recoverable from each other using the already available counts, so gains would be finite-capacity/training effects rather than information gains.

Post-interaction task tokens and direct summary skips both carry the changed representation. The suite cannot prove task routing, attention use, multi-task gradient conflict, or a temporal sequence mechanism.
All outcomes inherit released static snapshots, whole-window filtering/vocabulary and official_offline feedback; point-in-time production effectiveness is unestablished.
One seed, adaptive trajectory choice and aggregate AUC can hide user-cluster variation. Current coding jail provides no raw data, trained checkpoints or paired predictions for additional diagnostics.

The earlier sigmoid_count arm scales retrieval weights before BF16 value pooling; this suite scales the normalized pooled summary afterwards. They are algebraically equivalent in exact arithmetic but not bitwise equivalent in BF16. Historical scaled comparisons also carry this rounding-placement confound; within-suite controls share the new placement.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: The pinned benchmark code and primary benchmark summary verify the broad post-pooling field/task-token interaction pattern already inherited locally; original HiFormer paper text was unavailable. The earlier field-feedback designs were worse on click, so the card alone does not justify adopting a new block.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Retain inherited stacked field/static/summary/task interaction, replacing its one summary-scale bank with the declared paired-bank study. No hierarchical HiFormer block is newly introduced.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Two content/volume-scale banks with explicit inherited counts and direct summary skips, rather than the inspected single event-pooled field representation and heterogeneous blocks. Intensity motivation is known from DIN; originality unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: A split tie/failure against duplicate or fused replacements supplies no evidence for paired-bank organization, regardless of the external card.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Pinned tokenizer/forward and reversible mixing implementation were inspected. Global/group tokenization would change a different mechanism from the observed normalization tradeoff, so it is not adopted here; original full paper unavailable.

knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Paired scales of inherited global summaries, not global/group field chunking. No local TokenMixer comparison or reproduction is claimed.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: A later matched tokenizer or mixer replacement could make this reference relevant; current controls cannot establish its effectiveness or ineffectiveness.

observations.provenance: run://r-001 own-arm committed validation receipts; source files checked against hashes; no test feedback. No failed jobs are present among the nine supplied trials and previous_runtime_error is null. Other unavailable trajectories are not inferred.
observations.interpretation: Round0 field retrieval modestly exceeded event retrieval at matched capacity, while explicit feedback grouping reduced click quality. Round1 normalized sigmoid favored auxiliary AUC, count/mass scaling recovered click but remained below baseline; sum and count scaling were nearly identical. Softmax reference exactly reproduced field_global click AUC. These are one-seed controlled observations, not independent replications or proof of an intensity mechanism.
